title: Grand Hotel Esplanade, Berlin

buildingCutout.basis: Suppresses coincident generated building geometry only within the documented prewar hotel site during its historical appearance.

terrainReference.basis: Street-side original native terrain immediately in front of the historical central facade.

mapIdentity.provider: Berlin Landesarchiv Straube survey 1910 and Berlin 1928 aerial; Deutsche Bauzeitung 1913
mapIdentity.scope: The 1910 Berlin cadastral sheet fixes the old street wing corners. The original 1913 dimensioned drawings fix the expanded 94 m street frontage and plan. The Berlin survey aerial independently confirms the whole historic hotel and its garden and daylight courts in 1928.

note: Published street photograph and section drawings establish the horizontal five-storey facade with rusticated base and mansard and hipped roof breaks. The sections fix the scale of upper walls and roofs. The exact published Qualla garden photograph establishes the courtyard window rhythm, terrace and the circular fountain.
